items.title: How OpenAI Disrupted a Model-Distillation Campaign (5 minute read)
items.snippet: OpenAI detailed a real-world investigation into a coordinated adversarial-distillation campaign that manipulated model interactions to extract protected reasoning at scale.

items.title: The Den frees up 10-15 hours a week to grow with ChatGPT Work
items.snippet: As it opens a new location, the social club prepares grant applications in 2 hours instead of 3 days and liquor-license materials in 3 hours instead of 4 days.

items.title: Why I tried to kill token billing (and why we kept it)
items.snippet: Token billing is useful infrastructure, but usually a bad customer-facing pricing model. Your invoice should define the value your product delivers, not break down what it cost you to create it.
